description: Input, output, logs, and manifests use content-addressed local storage with retention, checksums, atomic publication, and download authorization. Optional conversion plugins are disabled by default and can run only when pinned, allowlisted, provenance-verified, and permitted for the tenant. Configurable redaction detects and removes declared sensitive patterns from converted output, previews, logs, and support bundles before publication. Converted content is treated as untrusted data and cannot change agent, tool, security, Jira, or benchmark authority.
